data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – Finanzamt Musterhafen
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterhafen issued Mara Beispiel's income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting income tax at €4,402.00 against withheld wage tax of €5,195.00, resulting in a refund of €793.00.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from the Finanzamt. It set your income tax at €4,402.00, which is less than the wage tax already withheld from your salary, so you get a refund of €793.00 paid to your known account within the next few days. If you think the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows until when you can decide. If you agree with it, there is nothing further to do. It may help to check the calculation against your own tax documents before the deadline passes.

items.title: Objection deadline (Einspruch) against the tax assessment
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the assessment if you disagree with the calculation
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final (bestandskräftig) and can generally no longer be challenged
